annotation.title_clean: RPA- Drone Registration – Civil Aviation Authority of Botswana
annotation.title_en: RPA- Drone Registration – Civil Aviation Authority of Botswana
annotation.venue: Civil Aviation Authority of Botswana website
annotation.summary_en: Civil Aviation Authority of Botswana web page setting out remotely piloted aircraft (drone) regulations: registration with security vetting, VLOS operation limits, altitude cap, age limit, incident reporting, payload and night-flying bans, and penalties up to BWP 50,000 or imprisonment.
key_provisions_or_claims: RPA up to 20kg MAUW must be registered with a numbered certificate; operators must be Botswana citizens or residents with police and security vetting
Flights limited to VLOS, below 400 ft AGL and within 500m; BVLOS only by special approval
Operator must be 18+; no night flights, dangerous goods or releasing objects without approval
Accidents involving injury or third-party damage must be reported within 10 days
Penalties up to BWP 5,000 and/or confiscation; up to BWP 50,000 and/or 2 years if used in crime
